# HORMONES (ED only)

## Prep data
```{r}
# load biocrates mappings
biocrates_pid <- read.csv("Data/Steroid Hormone Data/Data Files/Biocrates_matchingPIDtoSamplesID.csv") 

# load biocrates raw hormone data
biocrates_raw <- read.csv( "Data/Steroid Hormone Data/Data Files/Biocrates_Hormone_Data.csv") 

# load sample ID and plate mapping 
sampleID_plates <- read.csv("Data/Steroid Hormone Data/Data Files/Biocrates_SampleID_Plate_Mapping.csv")

# link sample IDs to PID 
hormone_data <- biocrates_pid %>%
  inner_join(biocrates_raw, by = c("SAMPLE.ID" = "Sample.identification")) %>%
  mutate(PID = as.character(PID))

hormone_data <- hormone_data %>%
  left_join(sampleID_plates, by = c("SAMPLE.ID"))

# keep only PIDs present in your ED-M6 metadata
hormone_data_paired <- hormone_data %>%
  inner_join(Metadata_Analysis %>% dplyr::select(PID), by = "PID")

# samples that were hemolytic 
# remove samples with hemolysis / turbidity
bad_samples <- c("842-1080", "842-1322", "830-1046", "825-1001", "846-1027", "867-1017", "841-1013", "841-1012", "829-1033", "829-1041", "828-1024", "833-1102", "833-1092", "828-1021", "846-1117", "842-1169", "873-1054")
length(bad_samples)

hormone_data_paired_filt <- hormone_data_paired %>%
  filter(!SAMPLE.ID %in% bad_samples)
# 193 samples to 184 

# identify hormone columns (everything that isn’t an ID/meta column)
non_hormone_cols <- c("SAMPLE ID", "PID", "Sample bar code", "Tube label", "Material", "Species", "Sample volume [µL]", "Plate")

hormone_cols <- setdiff(names(hormone_data_paired_filt), non_hormone_cols)

# analyte-specific LOD values
lod_df <- tibble(
  analyte = c("11-Deoxycorticosterone", "11-Deoxycortisol", "17-OHP", "Aldosterone", "Androstenedione", "Androsterone", "Corticosterone", "Cortisol", "Cortisone", "DHEA", "DHEAS", "DHT", "E1", "E2", "Etiocholanolone", "Progesterone", "Testosterone"),
  lod = c(0.021, 0.0040, 0.020, 0.074,
          0.017, 0.13, 0.0080, 0.094,
          0.038, 0.14, 47, 0.036,
          0.17, 0.073, 0.16, 0.038,
          0.0061)) %>%
  mutate(lod_sqrt2 = lod / sqrt(2))

lod_lookup <- setNames(lod_df$lod_sqrt2, lod_df$analyte)

# clean hormone values using analyte-specific LOD/sqrt(2) imputation
hormones_clean <- hormone_data_paired_filt %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(hormone_cols), as.character)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(hormone_cols), trimws)) %>%
  mutate(across(
    all_of(hormone_cols),
    ~ ifelse(.x == "< LOD", as.character(lod_lookup[cur_column()]), .x))) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(hormone_cols), readr::parse_number)) %>%
  dplyr::select(PID, all_of(hormone_cols))

# log2(x + 1) transformation
hormone_data_analysis <- hormones_clean %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(hormone_cols), ~ log2(.x + 1)))

dim(hormone_data_analysis) #184, 22 

#write.csv(hormone_data_analysis, "Data/Steroid Hormone Data/Analysis Data/Steroid_Hormone_ED_Data_Full_n273.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

## Batch effects 
```{r}
hormone_data_analysis_meta <- hormone_data_analysis %>%
  left_join(
    hormone_data_paired_filt %>% dplyr::select(PID, Plate),
    by = "PID") %>%
  mutate(Plate = factor(Plate))

colnames(hormone_data_analysis_meta) <- make.names(colnames(hormone_data_analysis_meta))

non_hormone_cols_safe <- make.names(non_hormone_cols)
hormone_cols_safe <- setdiff(names(hormone_data_analysis_meta), non_hormone_cols_safe)

hormone_batch_plate_summary <- map_dfr(hormone_cols_safe, function(horm) {
  
  df <- hormone_data_analysis_meta %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(horm), Plate) %>%
    na.omit()
  
  fit <- lm(reformulate("Plate", response = horm), data = df)
  aov_tbl <- anova(fit)
  ss_total <- sum(aov_tbl$`Sum Sq`)
  
  get_term_stats <- function(term_name) {
    ss <- aov_tbl[term_name, "Sum Sq"]
    p  <- aov_tbl[term_name, "Pr(>F)"]
    df_term <- aov_tbl[term_name, "Df"]
    tibble(
      Term = term_name,
      p.value = p,
      df = df_term,
      partial_R2 = ss / ss_total)
  }
  
  term_stats <- bind_rows(get_term_stats("Plate"))
  model_stats <- glance(fit)
  
  data_stats <- tibble(
    Hormone = horm,
    n = nrow(df),
    mean = mean(df[[1]], na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(df[[1]], na.rm = TRUE))
  
  term_stats %>%
    mutate(Hormone = horm) %>%
    left_join(data_stats, by = "Hormone") %>%
    mutate(
      model_R2 = model_stats$r.squared,
      adj_R2 = model_stats$adj.r.squared)
  
}) %>%
  mutate(FDR = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) %>%
  arrange(p.value) %>%
  mutate(Test = "ANOVA")

#write_csv(hormone_batch_plate_summary, "Data/Steroid Hormone Data/Analysis Data/Steroid_Hormone_Batch_Effect_Summary_3-23-2026.csv")

```

## Normality
```{r}
hormone_vars <- hormone_cols  # BEFORE make.names (use original names)

# raw matrix 
hormone_matrix_raw <- hormones_clean %>%
  filter(PID %in% hormone_matrix_clean$PID) %>%
  arrange(PID)

# log2 matrix 
hormone_matrix_log <- hormone_matrix_clean %>%
  arrange(PID)

summarize_wide_hormones <- function(df, vars) {
  df %>%
    summarise(
      across(
        all_of(vars),
        list(
          N = ~ sum(is.finite(.x)),
          Mean = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
          Median = ~ median(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
          SD = ~ sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
          Skewness = ~ e1071::skewness(.x, na.rm = TRUE, type = 2),
          Kurtosis = ~ e1071::kurtosis(.x, na.rm = TRUE, type = 2)),
        .names = "{.col}::{.fn}")) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      everything(),
      names_to = c("Hormone", ".value"),
      names_sep = "::") %>%
    relocate(Hormone)
}

# RAW
hormone_stats_raw <- hormone_matrix_raw %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(hormone_vars)) %>%
  summarize_wide_hormones(vars = hormone_vars) %>%
  mutate(Scale = "Raw") %>%
  relocate(Scale, .after = Hormone)

# LOG2
hormone_stats_log <- hormone_matrix_log %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(hormone_vars)) %>%
  summarize_wide_hormones(vars = hormone_vars) %>%
  mutate(Scale = "Log2") %>%
  relocate(Scale, .after = Hormone)

# COMBINE
hormone_stats_compare <- bind_rows(
  hormone_stats_raw,
  hormone_stats_log) %>%
  mutate(Scale = factor(Scale, levels = c("Raw", "Log2"))) %>%
  arrange(Hormone, Scale)

write.csv(hormone_stats_compare, "Data/Steroid Hormone Data/Analysis Data/Steroid_Hormone_ED_Data_184_Stat_Summary_3-23-2026.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```





# E2 (ED, WK2 & M6) (sensitive assay)
```{r}


E2_ED <- read.csv("Data/E2 Data/Data Files/Human_E2_ED_dataset.csv")
E2_WK2 <- read.csv("Data/E2 Data/Data Files/Human_E2_WK2_dataset.csv") %>%
  dplyr::rename(Pseudo_ID = Psuedo_ID)
E2_M6 <- read.csv("Data/E2 Data/Data Files/Human_E2_Mo6_dataset.csv")
mapping_file <- read.csv("Data/E2 Data/Data Files/Pseudo_ID_mapping_file.csv")

E2_ED_mapped <- E2_ED %>%
  left_join(
    mapping_file %>% filter(Timepoint == "ED") %>%
      dplyr::select(Pseudo_ID, PID),
    by = "Pseudo_ID"
  )

E2_WK2_mapped <- E2_WK2 %>%
  left_join(
    mapping_file %>% filter(Timepoint == "WK2") %>%
      dplyr::select(Pseudo_ID, PID),
    by = "Pseudo_ID"
  )

E2_M6_mapped <- E2_M6 %>%
  left_join(
    mapping_file %>% filter(Timepoint == "M6") %>%
      dplyr::select(Pseudo_ID, PID),
    by = "Pseudo_ID"
  )

sum(is.na(E2_ED_mapped$PID))
sum(is.na(E2_WK2_mapped$PID))
sum(is.na(E2_M6_mapped$PID))

E2_all <- bind_rows(
  E2_ED_mapped  %>% mutate(Timepoint = "ED"),
  E2_WK2_mapped %>% mutate(Timepoint = "WK2"),
  E2_M6_mapped  %>% mutate(Timepoint = "M6")
)

library(dplyr)

E2_ED_long <- E2_ED_mapped %>%
  transmute(
    PID,
    Timepoint = "ED",
    E2 = E2.Concentration..pg.ml._T0,
    E2_sqrt = E2.Concentration..pg.ml._T0_sqrt
  )

E2_WK2_long <- E2_WK2_mapped %>%
  transmute(
    PID,
    Timepoint = "WK2",
    E2 = E2.Concentration..pg.ml._T1,
    E2_sqrt = E2.Concentration..pg.ml._T1_sqrt
  )

E2_M6_long <- E2_M6_mapped %>%
  transmute(
    PID,
    Timepoint = "M6",
    E2 = coalesce(E2.Concentration..pg.ml._T2, E2.Concentration..pg.ml._T3),
    E2_sqrt = E2.Concentration..pg.ml._M6_sqrt,
    Date_Run = coalesce(Date.Run_T2, Date.Run_T3)
  )

E2_all <- bind_rows(E2_ED_long, E2_WK2_long, E2_M6_long) %>%
  filter(!is.na(PID), !is.na(E2))

E2_ED_only <- E2_all %>%
  filter(Timepoint == "ED") %>%
  distinct(PID, .keep_all = TRUE)
nrow(E2_ED_only) # 227

write.csv(E2_ED_long, "Data/E2 Data/Analysis Data/E2_Data_Full_n227.csv")


E2_ED_M6_pids <- E2_all %>%
  filter(Timepoint %in% c("ED", "M6")) %>%
  distinct(PID, Timepoint) %>%
  count(PID) %>%
  filter(n == 2) %>%
  pull(PID)
length(E2_ED_M6_pids) # 158

E2_ED_M6 <- E2_all %>%
  filter(PID %in% E2_ED_M6_pids, Timepoint %in% c("ED", "M6"))
nrow(E2_ED_M6) # 316

E2_ED_WK2_M6_pids <- E2_all %>%
  filter(Timepoint %in% c("ED", "WK2", "M6")) %>%
  distinct(PID, Timepoint) %>%
  count(PID) %>%
  filter(n == 3) %>%
  pull(PID)
length(E2_ED_WK2_M6_pids) #8

E2_ED_WK2_M6 <- E2_all %>%
  filter(PID %in% E2_ED_WK2_M6_pids, Timepoint %in% c("ED", "WK2", "M6"))

E2_ED_only_analysis <- E2_ED_only %>%
  filter(PID %in% ED_M6_paired_PIDs)
length(unique(E2_ED_only_analysis$PID)) # 150

write.csv(E2_ED_only_analysis, "Data/E2 Data/Analysis Data/E2_Data_ED26M_150_4-16-2026.csv")

E2_ED_M6_analysis <- E2_ED_M6 %>%
  filter(PID %in% ED_M6_paired_PIDs)
length(unique(E2_ED_M6_analysis$PID)) # 130 


E2_ED_WK2_M6_analysis <- E2_ED_WK2_M6 %>%
  filter(PID %in% ED_WK2_M6_paired_PIDs)
length(unique(E2_ED_WK2_M6_analysis$PID)) # 4 

```
